Open a graphics device that can render the plot font

Source: R/plots_utils.R
use_font_capable_device.Rd

Composing a figure measures text: grid::convertWidth() and friends do it directly, and ggplot2::ggplotGrob() does it again while it assembles the guides. That measurement runs on whatever graphics device is current. Setting options(device = ) is not enough, because it only decides what gets opened when no device is open at all; a device the caller already had open is used as it is, and a plain pdf() device cannot load the Computer Modern CID font the plot themes ask for. A stray device left behind by earlier code - another test file, an interactive session, a previous figure - then breaks a figure that is itself fine.

Opening a cairo device here makes the measurement independent of what the caller left behind. It is a no-op when cairo is unavailable, or when the current device is already a cairo one, so nesting these costs nothing.

Usage

use_font_capable_device()

Value

A function that closes the device this opened and makes the caller's previous device current again. Call it from on.exit().
